name: Wooden Bird House
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

 - Crafted from 5mm thick plywood, this wooden house is lightweight yet visually sturdy. The material offers a smooth surface perfect for precision printing and clean assembly.

 - Comes with 1-meter jute rope (3mm thick) to hang.

 - Size Options: Approx. 9.33x10.12x10.24 inches ~ 23.7x25.7x26 cm

 

  • Printing Technology:

Utilizing advanced UV printing technology, the box features vibrant, high-resolution designs printed on both the inside and outside surfaces. This double-sided printing ensures the product remains visually appealing from every angle.

 

  • Functionality & Usage:

 - This item is intended for indoor use and functions primarily as a decorative house or a charming accent piece for shelves, desks, or kids' rooms.

 - It also works wonderfully as a creative DIY project or personalized gift box.

 

  • Important Note:

 - Recommend for indoor use or covered area. Exposure to sun or rain may damage the print quality and the plywood structure over time.

 - Not designed to carry or support heavy objects. Best used for decoration, display, or gifting purposes.

 

  • Perfect Gift Idea:

 - Perfect gift for all ages and any occasions such as: Birthdays, Baby Showers, Christmas, Easter, Valentine’s Day, Teacher or coworker appreciation gifts

 - DIY craft activities for children or families.

 - Its aesthetic charm and customizable design make it a truly thoughtful and creative present.

 

  • Assembly Instructions:

Assembly is intuitive and requires no tools – a fun, engaging craft for both kids and adults! Please refer to the product detail image for more details:

 - Step 1: Insert the two side walls into the base panel:

Align the slots on each piece for a snug and stable fit.

 - Step 2: Attach the front and back panels:

These small side pieces lock the structure in place and help form the frame.

 - Step 3: Hang the roof panels:

Slide both roof sides into the hooks located on the top of the walls.

 - Step 4: Secure with rope:

Use the included 1-meter jute rope (3mm thick) by threading it through the holes and tying knots to fix the roof in place.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Wooden Bird House, 1-Meter Jute Rope

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.2 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 

 

  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.

 

  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.

 

  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.

 

  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.

 

  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.

 

  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

 

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.

 

  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
